howDepictsWasEstablished: Every file was opened and looked at. `depicts` is what the picture shows, never what the filename claims — the rule the twenty-captures failure this gate was built for came from. Dimensions, byte counts, sha256, opaque-pixel counts and distinct-RGBA counts are re-measured by this script and are the half a reader can check without opening anything.

deletionTests.zeroByte: no file in the directory is zero bytes; the smallest is 337.
deletionTests.exactDuplicateOfAPublishedFile: no byte-identical group contains a published file — the 4 groups cover 10 files (sweepL-status-t0.6.png, sweepL-status-t3.5.png; sweepL-wedged-t14.png, sweepL-wedged-t7.png; sweepK-theme-before.png, sweepL-wedged-recovered.png, sweepL-wedged-t1.png; overlay-exclusion-armed.png, overlay-exclusion-baseA.png, overlay-exclusion-baseB.png), and none of them is any subject's `shot`. The duplication is itself the evidence for DEF-221 and DEF-222, so deleting a member would delete the finding.
